logline: Four standalone Tamil crime dramas - each directed by a major filmmaker - confront the reality of victimhood in contemporary India, asking who is at risk and whether the system protects them.

seasons.review_body: Victim: Who Is Next? premiered on SonyLIV on August 5, 2022, an anthology of four standalone Tamil crime dramas jointly produced by Venkat Prabhu and G. Dillibabu under Black Ticket Company and Axess Film Factory. Each episode is directed by a different filmmaker from the Tamil New Wave - Chimbu Devan, M. Rajesh, Pa. Ranjith, and Venkat Prabhu - and stars a different cast including Nassar, Amala Paul, Priya Bavani Shankar, Kalaiarasan, Guru Somasundaram, and Prasanna. The shared theme is victimhood: who gets targeted, who is believed, who is left unprotected. The involvement of Pa. Ranjith brought particular critical attention given his track record with caste and social realist narratives. An uneven anthology, as the form demands, but the best episodes are genuinely urgent.
